summary: Implemented the africa_g2p skeleton under src/africa_g2p/ (loader, normalizer, fallback, G2P engine, English espeak wrapper, pipeline, cross-language converter with universal and proxy orthographies, IPA-to-orthography, and CLI), with only src files changed. The last full-suite run gave 197 passed, 1 failed, 16 skipped; the failure needs espeak-ng and a system English dictionary, which are absent here.
